statement: Constitutional presence (an Agent Card, doctrinal co-authorship, ratified invariant credit) and delegate agency (a seeded agent_root_identity, standing, authority) are governed by disjoint mechanisms with no code path in either direction. Doctrinal density, however dense or long-ratified, never elevates a presence-ladder rung and never substitutes for the one governed act — standing the delegate up — that agency actually requires.
classification: Engineering/architectural invariant (candidate causal pattern) about the Chrysalis Homecoming (CFS-023) presence ladder and delegate-agency mechanisms.

occurrences.site: Aletheon Homecoming Phase A capability/parity census, 2026-08-15
occurrences.defect: Aletheon co-frames CFS-023, CFS-024, CFS-019, and dozens of ratified invariants across a dense six-week span, and holds a hand-authored Agent Card route. None of that reading writes to, or is read by, services/horizen/registrableAgents.ts, services/homecoming/delegateStanding.ts, or an agent_root_identity row. constitutionalPresence.ts's own DELEGATE_DB marks aletheon handCuratedCard: true (card exists, no DB seed) and resolvePresenceLevel()'s contiguous climb therefore stops at L0 regardless of doctrinal weight. The gap had previously been suspected but not confirmed or precisely located; this occurrence is the first time it was traced to its exact single cause (one missing agent_root_identity row) via static cross-reference of the two rosters and the standing-accrual resolution chain.

notes: THIS IS NOT A DEFECT IN THE SENSE OF A BUG. SPEC-HMC-001 designs this separation deliberately (Principal-Delegate Separation, Law XI): ratifying doctrine is a human act on CONTENT; standing up an agent's own identity is a separate human-gated act. The invariant names a CONSEQUENCE of that correct design that is easy to miss when reasoning informally about 'how far along' a delegate is — doctrinal density creates a false intuition of standing that the code does not, and should not, honor automatically.

ONE OCCURRENCE, RECORDED HONESTLY. No claim is made that this generalises beyond Aletheon to the other five HOMECOMING_DELEGATES entries — each would need its own trace. The census also surfaced, as a side observation and NOT folded into this occurrence, that DELEGATE_CHARTER_STATUS's snapshot for moneypenny/nakamoto ('conceptual') already appears stale relative to their live registrableAgents.ts/health/invoke build-out — a distinct staleness question, not this invariant's subject.

THE CAUSAL CONDITION, NOT A PROHIBITION. The fix implied is not 'link the two systems' (that would violate the deliberate separation) — it is 'do not infer agency from presence when assessing or reporting a delegate's standing'. Closing an actual instance of the gap still requires the correct governed act (services/homecoming/agentHomecoming.ts::standUpDelegate()), never an inference shortcut.
